title: Supply Chain Graph policy v1
description: A versioned, deterministic policy. The engine evaluates an accepted snapshot against it; same snapshot, policy, and evaluation time always give the same result. A policy can route coverage gaps to review but has no way to declare them safe or resolved.

rules.description: Per-rule overrides keyed by rule ID. Unknown rule IDs are rejected so a typo cannot silently disable a rule.

failOn.description: Actionability values or severity labels that fail the gate. Empty means the gate is not configured and the evaluation only reports.

aliases.description: Optional opaque aliases for project IDs, used wherever a packet leaves the private environment.
